name: runesleo
description: Leo's agent tools: source-first reading, Polymarket research, signal digests, writing voice, multi-agent sync, explainer video.

plugins.name: x-reader
plugins.description: Read the original source behind a URL (X/Twitter, articles, YouTube, Bilibili, podcasts, WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Telegram, RSS) and report what was actually read versus missing.

plugins.name: polymarket-toolkit
plugins.description: Read-only Polymarket research for AI agents: wallet profiles, precise PnL, Brier scores and market scans from public APIs. No keys, no orders.

plugins.name: x-signal-digest
plugins.description: Stop scrolling X: turn a feed into up to three things worth knowing and at most one accountable decision, with receipts.

plugins.name: video-explainer-kit
plugins.description: Turn a brief, script or MP4 into a reviewed, verified vertical explainer video, with review receipts before publishing.

plugins.name: talk-human
plugins.description: Make AI-assisted writing sound like you: build a voice layer from your own speech samples, then run a three-pass de-slop edit.

plugins.name: multi-ai-sync
plugins.description: For people running several AI agents: check which agents' results and memory never reached your machine, and fix it.
